name: What is project closeout in construction?

mainEntity.name: What is project closeout in construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project closeout formally concludes a construction project, ensuring all contractual obligations are met. It involves final inspections, completing punch-list items, submitting closeout documents like warranties and as-builts, final payments, and transferring ownership to the client. This phase ensures the completed project meets all specifications and is ready for use, establishing a clear end to the construction period.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project closeout formally concludes a construction project, ensuring all contractual obligations are met and the site is ready for client use.
